notes.title: Linux/SteamOS Version On Air
notes.content:
I want to anounce that Lost Knight received update for Linux systems. Also it got gamepads compatibility updates and reworks (mostly on technical side).

Lost Knight was tested on several Ubuntu versions and on recent SteamOS for Steam Deck

Hope that this will extend your gaming experince
Thank you

notes.title: Ukrainian Localization is here!
notes.content:
Just letting everyone know that this game is supporting now Ukrainian language.

Thank you everyone for your support.

Take care!

notes.title: LOST KNIGHT RELEASE TODAY
notes.content:
After long year of work, we can finally present you [b]Lost Knight[/b].

I hope that you all glad to see Lost Knight release on Christmas. In honor of this event and to excuse for waiting so long, [i]Lost Knight[/i] will be available with a discount for whole week. [strike](game will be available in couple of hours)[/strike]

Thank you for hoping and waiting.
Merry Christmas and Have Fun!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest & Demo
notes.content:
We are presenting you Demo Version of Lost Knight after Steam Next Fest Event.

In this Demo we tried to apply all possible mechanics to test, how good (or bad) they are implemented.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40256052/c7d9f5081aa94a50d9e236e4a9462e822eb63dd5.png[/img]

We are welcome to see your feedback to make game as perfect as possible.
If you have any issues, don't be afraid to tell us what's wrong.

GL HF

-Pug Studio-
